text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaahahaha!! I can't get enough of 
this...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, struggle more, muuuuch more! Get 
me... all fired uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if her prayers had been answered... 
Still in Love gasped for a moment before 
her expression tightened with resolve. And 
just like that—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love! Still in Love! The leader 
is Still in Love! —And now, she crosses 
the finish liiine in first!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love! She achieves the Double 
Tiaraaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love achieved a brilliant Double 
Tiara... However, what awaited her first 
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Confusion, murmuring. The silence... 
gradually calms the excitement of a 
historic feat.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—What is that...? —The intensity is 
insane... —...It's kind of scary...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the sparse applause that had finally 
begun to rise at her back, Still in Love 
ran off..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...To make such a shameful display of 
myself... on such a grand stage... I..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. I am... so very 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
Congratulations on achieving the Double 
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That would mean you all were in the right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that way is stronger... and the right 
one, then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I have no parents. I have been all alone 
ever since I was born.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The people at the facility who raised me 
were all very kind. But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't change the fact that I'm all 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Guardians
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Amazing, Alve took 1st place 
again! Truly—a "prodigy"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because I was really, really strong. Even 
alone, I never lost.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume's Parents
text_block_list.text:
There, there... You tried your best! To 
us, you're our number one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—...Because she was stronger than anyone. 
Even compared to those girls who grew 
strong... encouraged and loved by 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because she never lost, not even once. 
Because even all on her own—she was 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To those two, I definitely... I will 
definitely...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, you had to see me in such an 
embarrassing state.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That girl... looked like she was having so 
much fun. To the point where my words 
couldn't even reach her...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
Still, you showed me your strength once 
again.

Still, you showed me your strength once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she ran out of control, today's 
race surely left an indelible mark on the 
crowd's hearts. Along with the undeniable 
strength of Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She claimed victory in both the Oka Sho 
and the Oaks with brilliant runs, despite 
each demanding different strengths. There 
is no way she can be swept aside this 
time."
choice_data_list:
You'll have even more cheers supporting 
you at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I lose control again... Everyone will 
surely give up on me...
choice_data_list:
That's why we're taking on the summer 
training camp—so that doesn't happen.

That's why I'm taking on the summer 
training camp—so that doesn't happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer is the season when Umamusume grow 
the most. Thus, Tracen Academy holds 
summer training camps to help them elevate 
their abilities.
choice_data_list:
Let's make your control even more flawless 
there!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: The Triple Tiara is right in front of you!
The Triple Tiara is right within reach!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine. I'm only a step away from my 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Let us win the Shuka Sho as well... and 
achieve—the Triple Tiara."
